rules.content:
/*
vect ransomware
*/

rule vect_Ransomnote
{
    meta:
        author = "ransomware.live"
        family = "ransomware.vect"
        description = "Detects vect ransomware ransom note or artifact"
        date = "2026-05-04"
        severity = 7
        score = 70

    strings:
        $name1 = "vect" ascii nocase
        $name2 = "VECT" ascii
        $onion  = "vect.onion" ascii nocase

    condition:
        any of them
}
